messages:
evan_sales: Heads-up — Bluestone sent an RFI. They want embedding throughput/latency numbers, licensing details for model variants, and the POC attachments. Target: ~2M embeddings/day, p95 < 120ms for 1536-d vectors. Can eng/ML/security confirm feasible approaches and a short RFI writeup?

sara_pm: Uploaded the initial RFI packet to the drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/bluestone/rfi (internal). I'll add a tab for 'perf targets' and 'legal asks'.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: bluestone-rfi-packet.zip (uploaded by sara_pm) :package: 

alex_se: Quick take: 120ms p95 is doable but depends on deployment mode and batching. For hosted dedicated pool we can hit ~80-110ms p95 with the curated embed model on A100-ish nodes with batch=32 and prefix caching. At steady 2M/day you'll want reserved capacity (Dedicated) or Private.

miguel_ml: Data points from tests: with embed-large-v2 (1536) on a single A100 we saw ~85ms p95 for batch=32, ~60ms p95 for single-request latency at low concurrency. Cost-wise ballpark: ~ $0.0008 per embedding if on hosted with optimized batching; dedicated brings unit cost down but requires commitment. If Bluestone can accept 1024-d vectors, expect ~20-30% latency + cost improvement.

jordan_security: Bluestone also asked about KMS/HSM and SOC2. We can provide SOC2 Type II report for hosted, and customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private. Hosted API: we do not persist raw inputs post-processing (see data retention policy). Dedicated/Private: can enable HSM-backed keystore (enterprise add-on).

ev an_sales: @alex_se @miguel_ml can you paste a short config snippet we can include in the RFI (what we'd recommend for POC infra)? Also need an answer for the licensing question: if they want to run our curated weights in Private do we provide redistributable license?

alex_se: Short answers: (1) POC infra: recommend Dedicated 2x A100 pods, autoscale to 4 during peak; enable prefix KV cache; batch target 32-64. (2) Licensing: for our curated models we provide redistribution rights under our enterprise agreement for Private deployments; if they bring third-party weights they must supply licensing evidence. I'll add a one-paragraph boilerplate.

alex_se: ```
# recommended dedicated pool (example)
dedicated_pool:
  instance_type: a100-80gb
  replicas: 2
  autoscale_max: 4
  batch_target: 32
  kv_cache: enabled
  quantization_profile: q4_0
```

miguel_ml: Also add this note: if they rely heavily on single-request low-latency (p95 < 50ms) we should use smaller models or reduce vector dims; continuous batching will always improve cost but can increase p95 under bursty traffic.

jordan_security: Legal/Compliance bullets for RFI: SOC2 Type II (available), ISO27001 (roadmap/ask), customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private, audit logs available on Dedicated (90/365 day retention options), support for VPC peering for data residency. I'll paste canned answers into the doc.

ev an_sales: Perfect. Can someone assemble a short capability matrix (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with bullets for latency p95 (typical), cost delta, and compliance options? Bluestone PM wants it in the next 24h.

sara_pm: I'll draft the capability matrix. Plan: two pages — 1) perf/cost bullets, 2) legal + licensing + POC timeline. POC timeline suggested: Week0 prep, Week1 smoke perf, Week2 perf tuning + eval, Week3 final report — 3-week active window, total 4 w/ prep.

alex_se: Uploading RFI answers and a short perf matrix now.
deploy-bot: File uploaded: bluestone_rfi_answers_v1.pdf (uploaded by alex_se) :white_check_mark:

miguel_ml: One more callout for the RFI: embedding dimensionality flexibility — call out optional support for 1024 vs 1536 dims, with sample perf numbers for both. Also include a small benchmark table (batch=1/16/32) and p95 numbers from our lab.
jordan_security: Bluestone asked about log retention & IP protection. Clarify: hosted offers ephemeral inference logs (retained only for system debugging per customer request), Dedicated can enable full audit logs with chosen retention, Private leaves retention to customer config. We'll provide the exact policy snippets.

ev an_sales: Thanks all. Action items: alex_se attach final PDF (done), sara_pm add matrix & schedule to the drive, miguel_ml add benchmark table, jordan_security drop the canned compliance answers. I'll send to Bluestone PM tomorrow AM. :thumbsup: 

sara_pm: Added the capability matrix tab and flagged items needing legal wording. Kicked off calendar invite: POC kickoff Wed 10am PT — @miguel_ml @alex_se requested, @jordan_security optional.

alex_se: noted, I'll be on the kickoff.
